tasks.subject: Task 1: DB Schema — Annual Patterns + Confirmations
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `typical_month`/`user_confirmed` columns to `recurring_patterns`; create `pattern_confirmations` table.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/api/src/db.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/index.ts` (debug endpoints)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `recurring_patterns` has `typical_month INTEGER`
- [ ] `recurring_patterns` has `user_confirmed INTEGER`
- [ ] `pattern_confirmations` table created with indexes
- [ ] All changes idempotent via `safeExec`
- [ ] All existing tests pass

**Verify:** `cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 "tests/**/*.ts"` → all pass


tasks.subject: Task 2: Annual Pattern Detection
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `detectPatterns()` detects annual (≈365-day) recurring patterns and surfaces large single-occurrence candidates for user confirmation.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/api/src/patterns.ts`
- Create: `apps/api/tests/patterns-annual.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 2 transactions 330-400 days apart, same counterparty → `pattern_type='annual'` with `typical_month`
- [ ] Single transaction ≥80€ with no existing pattern → `pattern_confirmations` record
- [ ] No duplicate confirmation on second run
- [ ] No confirmation if annual pattern already exists
- [ ] No confirmation for amounts <80€

**Verify:** `cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/patterns-annual.test.ts` → 5/5 pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/api/src/patterns.ts", "apps/api/tests/patterns-annual.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/patterns-annual.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["annual pattern detected from 2 occurrences", "confirmation candidate created for large single-occurrence", "no duplicate confirmations", "no confirmation when pattern exists", "no confirmation under threshold"]}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 4: Forecast Engine
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `forecast.ts` aggregates known recurring costs + calendar-month historical averages into 3-month projected spend; `GET /forecast` exposes it; `monthlyForecast()` warns when next month looks expensive.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/api/src/forecast.ts`
- Create: `apps/api/tests/forecast.test.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/briefing.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/index.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `computeMonthlyForecast(1)` returns correct shape
- [ ] `knownFixed` contains active subscriptions/recurring
- [ ] `annualItems` matches target month only
- [ ] `historicalAvg` averages same calendar month in prior years
- [ ] `projectedTotal` = max(historicalAvg, knownFixedTotal) + annualTotal
- [ ] `monthlyForecast()` returns warn when projected ≥1.3× recent avg
- [ ] `GET /forecast` returns 3-month array

**Verify:** `cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/forecast.test.ts` → 4/4 pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/api/src/forecast.ts", "apps/api/src/briefing.ts", "apps/api/src/index.ts", "apps/api/tests/forecast.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/forecast.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["computeMonthlyForecast returns correct shape", "knownFixed includes subscriptions", "annualItems matches month", "GET /forecast returns 3 months"]}
```
